name: Ullmer's Dairy Equipment & Fabrication
old_description: Whether you’re looking to buy or sell dairy equipment, need a refurbish, or require custom fabrication, Ullmer’s Dairy Equipment & Fabrication is your trusted partner. Our dedication to quality and personalized service makes us the premier choice for all your dairy equipment needs.
about:
Ullmer's Dairy Equipment & Fabrication operates from Pulaski, Wisconsin, where Francis Ullmer founded the business in 1991 with a single bulk tank sold from his front yard. The family-owned company grew into a 10-acre inventory of used cheese-making equipment in Northeast Wisconsin before Francis passed leadership to his son Paul after 22 years. Paul added a fabrication shop to produce food-grade stainless steel equipment built to individual customer specifications.

Today the shop combines a skilled design team with experienced fabricators to deliver custom stainless steel tanks, vats, pasteurizers, presses, and conveyors for sanitary processing. The facility also refurbishes and resells used dairy machinery, maintaining a large stock of batch pasteurizers, cheese vats, CIP systems, and related accessories. In-house engineering supports both one-off prototypes and repeat production runs.

The company serves cheese plants, dairies, food and beverage processors, and other sanitary-industry customers across the upper Midwest. Its equipment also reaches wineries, breweries, maple syrup producers, honey operations, and educational institutions that require food-grade fabrication.

Ullmer's emphasizes honesty, integrity, and customer satisfaction, citing state-of-the-art technology and deep industry expertise as the basis for exceeding expectations rather than simply meeting them.
